items.title: Build zero-trust AI agents with Google's Agent Development Kit
items.content: Building autonomous AI agents that mutate production state requires moving beyond soft system prompts to a robust zero-trust architecture. To secure Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) workflows against prompt injections and malicious execution, developers must implement hardware-backed cryptographic signatures for database writes, kernel-level sandboxing with gVisor for dynamic code, and deterministic semantic gateways for I/O validation. By enforcing these hard security boundaries at the infrastructure level, you can safely deploy multi-tool AI agents without risking unauthorized data manipulation or server compromise.

summaries.zh: 谷歌Agent开发工具包（ADK）构建零信任AI代理，需超越软性提示词，采用强健架构。具体措施包括：对数据库写入实施硬件级加密签名，利用gVisor进行内核级沙箱隔离动态代码，并部署确定性语义网关验证I/O。在基础设施层面强制这些安全边界，可安全部署多工具AI代理，防止未经授权的数据篡改或服务器入侵。
summaries.en: To securely deploy autonomous AI agents with Google's Agent Development Kit, soft system prompts are insufficient. A zero-trust architecture is required, implementing hardware-backed cryptographic signatures for database writes, kernel-level sandboxing using gVisor for dynamic code, and deterministic semantic gateways for I/O validation. Enforcing these infrastructure-level security boundaries protects against prompt injections and malicious execution, preventing unauthorized data manipulation and server compromise in multi-tool agent workflows.

items.title: HeyGen x Google Cloud: Bringing Avatar IV to TPUs
items.content: HeyGen ported their 18B+ parameter Avatar IV video generation model to Google Cloud's Trillium (v6e) TPUs via torchax and XLA, utilizing FSDP and Ulysses sequence parallelism across an eight-chip mesh. To achieve a 1.86x speedup for real-time streaming, the engineering team pipelined exposed all-to-all collectives, aligned sparse attention block sizes to eliminate mask padding, and bypassed softmax serial dependencies using a precomputed Cauchy-Schwarz upper bound. These custom Pallas kernel and compiler optimizations were deployed only after passing rigorous two-tier quality gates to guarantee byte-identical or mathematically equivalent pixel outputs.

items.title: Introducing Credentio: Open Source C++ Library for C2PA Content Credentials from Google
items.content: Credentio is a newly released, open-source C++ library from Google that allows developers to integrate high-performance, local-first validation of C2PA Content Credentials into their client and server applications. By processing assets entirely locally with a highly optimized memory footprint, the library delivers instant validation verdicts for multi-gigabyte media files without incurring cloud latency, bandwidth costs, or data privacy risks. The library currently features deep manifest parsing alongside configurable trust list integration, and is available now on Google Source with future plans to support full credential generation and embedding.

summaries.zh: 谷歌发布开源 C++ 库 Credentio，用于集成 C2PA 内容凭证的验证。该库支持本地优先的高性能处理，内存占用优化，可对数 GB 级媒体文件即时给出验证结果，无需云端传输，避免延迟、带宽成本和隐私风险。目前提供深度清单解析和可配置可信列表集成，已发布于 Google Source。未来计划支持完整的凭证生成与嵌入功能。

It processes assets entirely on-device, enabling instant verification of multi-gigabyte media files while avoiding cloud latency, bandwidth costs, and privacy concerns. Currently, Credentio offers deep manifest parsing and configurable trust list integration. It is available on Google Source, with future plans to support full credential generation and embedding.

items.title: Mastering Edge AI on Raspberry Pi with LiteRT and Gemma
items.content: Deploying secure, real-time Edge AI on Raspberry Pi is now simplified using LiteRT and lightweight Gemma open models. LiteRT optimizes CPU and GPU performance, delivering fast token speeds for models like Gemma4, enabling real-time local reasoning for robotics. Developers can quickly convert, quantize, and run these models using the lightweight LiteRT CLI tool. Support for Hailo AI accelerators is also coming very soon.

items.title: Why Go is an Ideal Language for AI-Assisted Software Engineering
items.content: As AI coding assistants shift the developer's primary role from writing boilerplate to reviewing and maintaining systems, language choice becomes critical for long-term architectural integrity. Go directly addresses this new paradigm by utilizing its strict compiler, integrated toolchain, and uncompromising readability to provide deterministic guardrails that help AI models self-correct and generate highly standardized code. By enforcing ecosystem-wide consistency and strict backward compatibility, the Go platform empowers engineering teams to efficiently verify, optimize, and maintain high-velocity, AI-generated output in production environments.

By enforcing ecosystem-wide consistency and strict backward compatibility, the Go platform empowers engineering teams to efficiently verify, optimize, and maintain high-velocity, AI-generated output in production environments.

The language’s ecosystem-wide consistency and backward compatibility further enable engineering teams to verify, optimize, and maintain AI-generated output efficiently in production. Overall, Go helps preserve architectural integrity while working with high-velocity AI tools.

items.title: Agent Plugins package your skills, tools, and more
items.content: Agent Plugins 1.0.0 is a new, vendor-neutral directory specification—backed by Google, Amazon, Microsoft, and others—for packaging Agent Skills and MCP servers into a single portable unit. By standardizing the manifest (plugin.json) and utilizing a fixed directory layout, it eliminates the need for developers to maintain separate wrappers or configurations to support different AI coding agents and IDEs. Google has officially joined as a Core Maintainer and already rolled out support in the Agents CLI and Data Agent Kit, allowing developers to start building and distributing interoperable plugins today.

items.title: Scaling AI Agent Infrastructure with the MCP Stateless updates
items.content: The 2026-07-28 Model Context Protocol (MCP) specification replaces legacy stateful constraints with a fully stateless core, enabling cloud-native horizontal scaling, serverless deployments, and standard round-robin load balancing. This architectural shift introduces standardized HTTP headers for efficient routing without deep packet inspection, caching controls, and Multi Round-Trip Requests (MRTR) to handle interactive and long-running tasks without blocking connections. Developers can immediately begin migrating their agentic applications to this highly scalable infrastructure using the newly available beta SDKs for Python, TypeScript, Go, and C#.

items.title: Model routing with Google Cloud API Gateway
items.content: Google Cloud API Gateway now offers a model routing feature in Public Preview, allowing developers to dynamically route traffic to models like Gemini, Claude, or OpenAI OSS-GPT without hardcoding endpoints or managing open-source proxies. Developers can easily configure these routing rules directly within their OpenAPI 3.x specifications by mapping virtual model names to specific backend targets on a shared host. Once deployed, the Gateway acts as a serverless ingress layer that accepts standard OpenAI-compatible requests, automatically transcodes the payload to the native schema of the target model, and routes the traffic on the fly.

Once deployed, the Gateway acts as a serverless ingress layer that accepts standard OpenAI-compatible requests, automatically transcodes the payload to the native schema of the target model, and routes the traffic on the fly.

summaries.zh: Google Cloud API Gateway 推出模型路由功能（公开预览版），允许开发者动态将流量路由至 Gemini、Claude 或 OpenAI OSS-GPT 等模型，无需硬编码端点或自行管理开源代理。开发者可直接在 OpenAPI 3.x 规范中配置路由规则，将虚拟模型名称映射到共享主机上的特定后端目标。部署后，网关作为无服务器入口层，接受标准 OpenAI 兼容请求，自动将负载转码为目标模型的原生结构，并实时进行流量路由。
summaries.en: Google Cloud API Gateway has introduced a model routing feature in Public Preview, enabling developers to dynamically route AI traffic to models such as Gemini, Claude, or OpenAI OSS-GPT without hardcoding endpoints or managing open-source proxies. Routing rules can be configured directly in OpenAPI 3.x specifications by mapping virtual model names to specific backend targets on a shared host. Once deployed, the Gateway serves as a serverless ingress layer, accepting standard OpenAI-compatible requests, automatically transcoding payloads to each target model’s native schema, and routing traffic in real time.

items.title: Scaling real-time AI agents with session-aware load balancing
items.content: Real-time AI agents break traditional request-response load balancing paradigms because they rely on long-lived, stateful bidirectional streams that obscure true server capacity. To solve this, developers must implement application-level session tracking directly within the runtime to accurately measure the committed concurrent workload of active conversations. By feeding these precise session counts alongside standard CPU utilization metrics into a hybrid routing algorithm, infrastructure can effectively distribute stateful AI traffic and prevent individual backend bottlenecks.

items.creator: Google

summaries.zh: 实时 AI 代理依赖长时间存续、有状态的双向数据流，打破了传统请求-响应式负载均衡的假设，使真实服务器容量难以判断。为解决这一问题，开发者需在运行时内实现应用层会话跟踪，准确统计当前会话的并发负载。将精确的会话数连同标准 CPU 利用率指标，共同输入混合路由算法，即可有效分发有状态 AI 流量，避免单个后端成为瓶颈。
summaries.en: Real-time AI agents rely on long-lived, stateful bidirectional streams, which break conventional request-response load balancing by obscuring true server capacity. To address this, developers must implement application-level session tracking within the runtime to accurately measure committed concurrent workloads. These precise session counts, combined with standard CPU utilization metrics, feed into a hybrid routing algorithm. This approach enables effective distribution of stateful AI traffic, preventing individual backend bottlenecks and supporting scalable infrastructure.

items.title: Enable on-demand expertise with Agent Skills in Genkit Go
items.content: To prevent context window bloat and reduce token consumption, Genkit Go introduces Agent Skills based on a progressive disclosure architecture. Developers can package specialized instructions, scripts, and references into modular SKILL.md bundles where only the frontmatter metadata is initially exposed to the agent's system prompt. When a task matches the skill's description, Genkit's middleware dynamically loads the full instruction body and associated assets, ensuring the model accesses precise workflows exactly when needed.

When a task matches the skill's description, Genkit's middleware dynamically loads the full instruction body and associated assets, ensuring the model accesses precise workflows exactly when needed.
items.creator: Google

summaries.zh: Genkit Go 推出了 Agent Skills 功能，旨在防止上下文窗口膨胀并降低令牌消耗。该功能基于渐进式披露架构，开发者可将专业指令、脚本和参考资料打包为模块化的 SKILL.md 文件，初始仅在系统提示中暴露 frontmatter 元数据。当任务匹配技能描述时，Genkit 的中间件会动态加载完整的指令主体和相关资源，确保模型仅在需要时获取精确的工作流程，实现按需专业知识调用。
summaries.en: Genkit Go introduces Agent Skills to support on-demand expertise while reducing token consumption and preventing context window bloat. Using a progressive disclosure architecture, developers package specialized instructions, scripts, and references into modular SKILL.md bundles. Only frontmatter metadata is initially exposed to the agent’s system prompt. When a task matches a skill’s description, Genkit middleware dynamically loads the full instruction body and related assets, giving the model precise workflows exactly when needed.

items.summary: Genkit Go 推出了 Agent Skills 功能，旨在防止上下文窗口膨胀并降低令牌消耗。该功能基于渐进式披露架构，开发者可将专业指令、脚本和参考资料打包为模块化的 SKILL.md 文件，初始仅在系统提示中暴露 frontmatter 元数据。当任务匹配技能描述时，Genkit 的中间件会动态加载完整的指令主体和相关资源，确保模型仅在需要时获取精确的工作流程，实现按需专业知识调用。
